title: Cornucopias - COPI Cafe Episode 15
description:
In this latest episode of COPICafe, Cornucopias CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones discuss the latest events from within the Cornucopias metaverse game. Rob and Josh are joined by Dan Gambardello with Crypto Capital Ventures to discuss his introduction to Cardano and all things Cornucopias. Listen to the corn-brains behind it all as they discuss Cornucopias' latest developments.
